verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a Marketing Emails REST API for creating, updating and retrieving emails programmatically, plus an `hs` CLI, so parts of the product can be driven without the UI. Nothing in the evidence shows CI use: no non-interactive auth, no CI pipeline guidance, and no headless execution of campaigns or other workflows. missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration, non-interactive CLI authentication for pipelines, headless coverage beyond marketing-email endpoints, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can use the Marketing Emails API to programmatically create, update, and get details about marketing emails.
To retrieve a list of all emails, make a `GET` request to `/marketing/v3/emails`
You can check which version of the CLI you have installed by running `hs --version`.
